n_start: Hello, friends! Let's find out why Hong Kong has four seasons.
n_m1: First, let's say hello. Can you tap Mimi the cat?
n_m2: Why is summer so hot? Let's count the sunshine! Turn the Earth, and help Mimi catch every little sun.
n_m2ok: Eight suns! In summer, Mimi's day is long. She gets lots and lots of sunshine. That's why it's hot!
n_m3: Which hat should Mimi wear on a hot summer day? A sun hat, or a woolly hat?
n_m3ok: Yes! A sun hat for hot, sunny days.
n_m4: Now let's go on a trip around the Sun! Hold the button, and fly to autumn.
n_m4ok: It's autumn! Six suns this time. A little less sunshine, so the air is cool. A lovely day to fly a kite.
n_m5: Keep flying, all the way to winter.
n_m5ok: Brrr! It's winter in Hong Kong.
n_m6: How much sunshine does Mimi get now? Turn the Earth one whole turn, and catch the suns.
n_m6ok: Only four suns! In winter, Mimi's day is short, and her night is long. Just a little sunshine. That's why it's cold.
n_m7: Here's a tricky one. Look at the chart. When does Mimi get more sunshine? In summer, or in winter?
n_m7ok: You got it! Lots of sunshine in summer. Just a little in winter.
n_m8: But why? Look for the red ball on top of the Earth. Tap it!
n_m8ok: That's the top of the Earth. See? The Earth leans over, and it always leans the same way. In summer, the top leans toward the Sun. In winter, it leans away.
n_m9: Now, who lives near the top of the Earth? Find Sam the bear, and tap him!
n_m9ok: Watch Sam go around. No suns at all! In Sam's winter, the Sun never comes up. It's dark all day long.
n_m10ok: It's spring! Six suns again. The days are getting longer. Flowers come out, and there's a little rain.
n_m11: Last one! Fly back to summer.
n_m11b: And look at Sam! Twelve suns! In Sam's summer, the Sun never goes to bed.
n_m11ok: Summer again! One whole trip around the Sun is one whole year.
n_fin: You did it! The Earth leans as it goes around the Sun. So we get more sunshine, then less sunshine. That's why we have four seasons, and why they are different in different places. Great job, everyone!
n_hint3: Hmm. It's very hot today. Which hat keeps the Sun away?
n_hint7: Look at the chart. Which one has more suns?
n_hint8: Look for the little red ball, on top of the Earth.
n_play: Play time! Turn the Earth to catch the sunshine, or fly around the Sun. Tap Mimi or Sam to count their suns.
a_hi: Hi! I'm Mimi! I live in Hong Kong. Phew! It's summer, and I'm so hot!
a_sp1: Spring! I can smell the flowers.
a_sp2: It's warm, and a little bit rainy.
a_wi2: It's cold, but there's no snow in Hong Kong.
b_hi: Hello! I'm Sam! I live near the top of the Earth, where it's icy cold.
b_su1: It's summer! The Sun is up all day, and all night.
b_au1: Autumn! The nights are getting long.
b_wi1: Brrr! Winter is a good time for a long sleep.
s_hi: Hello! I'm the Sun! I stay in the middle, and the Earth goes around me.
s_2: I'm just as far away all year. It's the lean that makes the seasons!
n_hint9: Sam is the sleepy bear, near the red ball.
